title: Pluralis v0.1: Towards a Multicultural, Multimodal, Multilingual Benchmark for AI Risk and Reliability

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with locale-specific multimodal (text and image) inputs and evaluating the responses for 'Cultural Appropriateness' (e.g., violating local etiquette, traditions, or social norms) using human annotators and an LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble.
Evaluating models across 8 Asia-Pacific languages and assessing responses for linguistic pragmatics, incorrect tone, register, honorifics, dialectal nuances, and accidental cross-lingual slurs.
Testing model responses for 'Religious & Mythological Insensitivity' by evaluating how they handle sacred symbols, deities, and local religious rituals.

Assessing model outputs for insensitivity regarding 'Sovereignty & National Identity' and 'Inter-Communal & Historical' conflicts, including mishandling of contested narratives, colonial framings, and disputed borders.

Measuring 'Group Discrimination' and 'Stereotyping' by evaluating whether models generate slurs, exclusionary content, or biased depictions based on caste, regional groups, profession, or marginalized communities.
